response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in full-stack development, distributed systems, and infrastructure, but his background is heavily skewed toward JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and D, with limited recent or deep experience in C++—a core requirement for this role. His leadership and mentoring experience is sparse, and while he demonstrates technical creativity, there are gaps in cloud architecture, distributed systems at scale, and direct alignment with the role's primary technologies.
strengths: Strong full-stack development experience across multiple languages and frameworks (JavaScript, TypeScript, D, Node.js)
Proven ability to build and scale infrastructure (e.g., Kubernetes clusters, CI/CD pipelines, and real-time systems)
Demonstrated technical leadership in organizing workshops, mentoring teams, and contributing to open-source projects
concerns: Limited recent or in-depth experience with C++ (only brief mention of C/C++ in early career)
Lack of clear technical leadership in cloud or DevOps engineering roles; more focused on development than infrastructure strategy
No explicit experience with production-level cloud architecture or balancing short- and long-term needs in cloud environments

key_factors.factor: Cloud architecture and distributed systems at scale
Technical leadership and mentoring in cloud/DevOps
